title: Order of the remaining cuts
situation: The reconstitution and delivery cuts are integrated into dev. 0116 rescopes cut 7 and leaves the context map's contracts as a cut of their own.
decision: Cut 7, meaning roles (0116); then the contracts cut: the context map records each contract, the examples a consuming context writes of what it needs from another, and runs them in both contexts; then a consumer trial, kino on a film-production project, which needs the operator's project and so waits for the operator; then the ipseic round (0048), after the trial. Each cut ends integrated into dev under the operator's standing delegation; pushing stays the operator's.
consequences: Work runs without the operator until the consumer trial.
